arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS prepaid_debit_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made with cards whose type is prepaid debit, across the whole data period.
assumptions: Prepaid debit cards are those with card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'; regular 'Debit' cards are excluded.
All transactions are counted, including those with errors or negative amounts, over the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
